svg.title: Geotechnical engineer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as geotechnical engineer, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed core-sampling tube penetrates three separated ground horizons, which stop at the tube walls. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
